children: Here’s a challenge. Using the five clues below, identify the company that is being talked about here.
1 I recently completed three decades since beginning my manufacturing business and recently crossed a billion dollars in annual revenue.
2 My founder is a first-generation entrepreneur with a strong academic background in my industry and holds a master’s degree from IIM Ahmedabad.
3 My founder took 50 years to become a billionaire. Hopefully, his son, who graduated from Wharton and now holds a senior operating role, will scale faster.
4 I have had two globally respected private equity investors as shareholders over the last two decades, both of whom have now completely exited with outstanding returns.
5 Despite trading below its IPO offer price after listing, my stock doubled within the next two years.

title: Who Am I? October 18, 2026
